account: The Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat submitted the proposal, with Dr. Vinay Kaushik as its contact. The proposed generative AI system combines virtual try-on and garment design. The intended benefits are lower returns, less waste and improved opportunities for artisans. The demonstrations that the submission lists under testbeds belong to others, such as the Looklet dressing room demo and the Outfit Anyone demo on Hugging Face. The submission describes the project's own proof of concept as future work. No source reports that any shopper, artisan or business has used the system.
